summary:

title: Beyond polyester: 5 materials reshaping textile innovation
summary:
Textile innovation is accelerating beyond polyester as sustainability regulations, microplastic concerns and circularity targets reshape material priorities.
Algae fibres, mycelium biofabrics, graphene-enhanced cellulose and waste-derived feedstocks are emerging as key alternatives.
Advanced regenerated cellulose currently appears the most commercially scalable challenger to virgin polyester.

title: USDA’s Great American Cotton Plan to revitalise cotton farm economy
summary:
USDA has launched the Great American Cotton Plan to bolster the cotton farm economy, restore textile manufacturing, expand cotton trade opportunities and raise demand for products made with American-grown cotton.

title: British luxury brand Burberry pushes 'Net Zero' ambition to 2050
summary:

The revision comes amid broader corporate restructuring under measures aimed at restoring profitability.

summary:

summary:

summary:

With EPR rules expanding, circular fashion is shifting from a sustainability narrative towards a policy-driven industrial system.
